title: Angle Brackets
instructions: To make a class work with any type, you add a type parameter in special brackets after the class name. What kind of brackets do you use?
prompt: To make a class work with any type, add a type parameter in _____ after the class name.
explanation: You use angle brackets `<>` to declare a type parameter. For example, `class Box<T>` uses angle brackets to hold the type parameter `T`. This tells Kotlin that `T` is a placeholder for a real type that will be provided when an instance is created.
